answer: Proposed: quartz freight agents at a harbor get one daily rebate per key after a VDF seeded by that key and a fresh beacon: 100 million sequential steps. Validators check proofs; missing or invalid proofs earn nothing. CPUs are reusable capital; electricity recurs; no stake is locked. Faster chips or outsourcing can lower costs; profitable rebates still attract Sybils. Assuming no cross-key shortcut, shared CPUs cannot reuse work: one thread per key lets ten keys run in parallel, but they still need 1 billion steps.
